source: Daily queue and catch-up, Home states; day = dayNumber(now, utcOffsetMin). Card state comes from replaying the input logs. Input entries are live; cards are live Cards. reshow is ordered by card id (unsigned bytes). dueToday.toReview = steps 1 + 3, dueToday.new = step 2

cases.note: 150 waiting, normalLoad 50 → catch-up, quota 50 + ceil(100/3) = 84; no new Cards
120 waiting + 10 reviewed today = 130 → quota 77, 67 left today
load exactly 2 × normalLoad = 100 → no catch-up, all due plus new
normalLoad = 51 from the last 14 active days (T−14…T−1, 51 started reviews each); the 15th active day (T−15, a first review only) and T−20 are outside the window
